display.purpose: Large orientation statements and the primary sidebar message.

body.purpose: Readable explanations designed to work for both scanning and read-aloud use.

shadows.name: shell-ambient
shadows.purpose: Softly lift the overall setup frame from the page background.

shadows.name: avatar-lift
shadows.purpose: Give the central profile avatar a gentle focal lift.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The clear next action in setup and confirmation flows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 50px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid #2f6f4f; border-radius: 8px; background: #2f6f4f; color: #fff; font-weight: 900; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #204d38; }

components.name: Field
components.description: A high-contrast, touch-friendly field for practical profile details.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #cfd7ce; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #17211d; } .ds-field:focus { outline: 3px solid rgba(51, 92, 129, 0.28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Support Circle Visual
components.description: Initial-based avatars and orbit rings make trusted support tangible without requiring photography.
components.css: .ds-support-circle { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 220px; } .ds-avatar { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 999px; background: #335c81; color: #fff; font-weight: 900; } .ds-avatar-primary { width: 94px; height: 94px; background: #c85f4d; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(47, 111, 79, 0.22); }

narrative.overview: Count Me In is expressed as a calm, warm setup space for a family member helping an older adult. The current interface uses a deep green progress rail, softly tinted paper-like surfaces, generous copy, and human circular avatars. Its palette, 8px geometry, and Inter type system are incumbent implementation choices and may evolve while warmth, clarity, dignity, and low-pressure support remain stable.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces against a calm green anchor.
Clear step-by-step progression and readable headings.
Softly lifted cards with restrained borders.
Human support represented through circles, initials, and orbit motifs.

rules.name: The Low-Pressure Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent colors clarify trust, support, or state; they do not create urgency or promotion.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Use depth for the calm container or meaningful focal point; do not make every card float.

dos: Do keep hierarchy explicit through scale, weight, and one-screen-at-a-time progression.
Do preserve strong focus states and large touch-friendly controls.
Do use circles and initials to express people, trust, and support.
donts: Don't introduce urgency, gamification, or promotional visual language.
Don't hide approval or sharing boundaries behind decorative UI.
Don't rely on color alone to communicate progress, permission, or errors.
